name: Anagnorisis (The Aha-Moment)
axiom: The insight lands when the audience sees two readings were one figure.
trigger: Research reveals and strategic unveilings, where the conclusion must feel discovered rather than asserted.

steps.text: Show the figure the audience already reads one way.
Add the evidence that makes the other reading visible.
Let the shift happen; do not narrate it.
Name the consequence of the new reading.

antiPattern.violation: Announcing the insight before the evidence, which turns a discovery into a claim the audience now argues with.
antiPattern.remediation: Withhold the conclusion until the second reading is available. The order is the effect.
